```{python}
from datetime import timedelta
from strom.echarts import echarts_period_comparison

last_year = int(daily["year"].max())
unique_years = daily["year"].unique()
prev_years = unique_years[unique_years != last_year]

# shift previous years onto the dates of the current period
daily["date_day"] = daily["date"]
for y in prev_years:
    daily.loc[daily["year"] == y, "date_day"] += timedelta(365 * (last_year - int(y)))

echarts_period_comparison(daily, y="nd_cum", current_year=last_year, yaxis_title="kWh - Kumulierter Verbrauch")
```


```{python}
from datetime import timedelta
from strom.echarts import echarts_period_comparison

last_year = int(daily["year"].max())
unique_years = daily["year"].unique()
prev_years = unique_years[unique_years != last_year]

# shift previous years onto the dates of the current period
daily["date_day"] = daily["date"]
for y in prev_years:
    daily.loc[daily["year"] == y, "date_day"] += timedelta(365 * (last_year - int(y)))

echarts_period_comparison(daily, y="wd_cum", current_year=last_year, yaxis_title="kWh - Kumulierter Verbrauch")
```
